text:
Which statement about the radioactive decay of a substance is correct?
A
It cannot be predicted when a particular nucleus will decay.
B
Placing a radioactive substance inside a lead-lined box prevents it from decaying.
C
The decay always produces poisonous gases.
D
The rate of decay increases if the substance is dissolved in water.

options.label: A
options.text: It cannot be predicted when a particular nucleus will decay.

options.label: B
options.text: Placing a radioactive substance inside a lead-lined box prevents it from decaying.

options.label: C
options.text: The decay always produces poisonous gases.

options.label: D
options.text: The rate of decay increases if the substance is dissolved in water.
